integrity: Proof and standalone reproducible computations are supplied. This is an internal self-review, not independent audit or externally certified priority.
limitations: Sunlets with one pendant per cycle vertex only, n at least three. It does not solve enumeration for arbitrary unicyclic graphs, nor count edge colorings. A 2026 paper on unicyclic edge-open packing bounds was unavailable in full; an earlier equivalent transfer formulation under another name remains possible.
title: Edge-open-packing polynomial and extremal multiplicities of sunlet graphs
